gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes are what you notice first. Noto Sans Sunuwar sits beneath as a plain sans with generous curves and short ascender stems, softening the heading's drawn-with-one-pen-tip precision.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri keeps short ascenders and a tall x-height, with an a that lets its lower bowl breathe. Tektur is the louder one, its outsized lowercase and open curve endings built for display, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri handles the quiet work.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac reads like blown glass, with tall rounded bowls and s shapes that turn wide and easy. Tektur holds every stroke at a single width, no brush swell, so it gives those soft bulbs a crisp, engineered frame to sit under.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Noto Sans Tai Le reads quietly, its sans strokes tapering out before they touch and its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. Tektur then draws every stroke at one thickness, and that rigid heading makes the gentle body feel even softer.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Noto Sans Tai Tham crowds its chalk-board lowercase up toward the capital line, with a c you can see right into. Tektur's joins are as thick as its strokes, so Noto Sans Tai Tham looks lighter and more relaxed beneath it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Tektur draws curves as thick as a drawn thread, with generous openings at every terminal. Noto Sans Tamil follows as a sans that looks magnified, its terminals stopping well short of the stem, so the two feel both bold and open.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes have the steadiness of a drawn string, and its lowercase runs oversized for a display face. Noto Sans Tangsa is the plain sans partner, wide and inviting.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-thai: Tektur's pipe-cleaner strokes, with no thin parts and no swell, give it a distinctive, expressive look. Noto Sans Thai is its plain sans foil, swollen like glass beads and left open.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Noto Sans Tifinagh reads open and inviting, with rounded lowercase bowls that fill the line like inflated shapes. Tektur's strongest quality is its pipe-cleaner stroke, where n arches match the stems beside them, a rigid, drawn look that makes the soft sans-serif feel even rounder.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Tektur draws each letter like a sign-painter's single brush stroke at constant width, with big open curve endings. And Noto Sans Tirhuta, a sans-serif with cut-back terminals and a dominant x-height, carries a long read without any fuss.
